description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/weather/forecast (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Not an official forecast service; not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA/NWS. For life-safety decisions use weather.gov and local authorities. Up to 60 s old. Charged per answer; bad input and points outside NWS coverage are refused before settlement and not charged. USDC on Base only.
